summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Deployed TensorRT YOLO detection at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson, ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation with ±8% reconstruction error, and YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) for ADAS sensing — all in Python and C++ with tight hardware-software integration.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.
Designed a custom wavelet bank for noise suppression; achieving PSNR of 86 vs baseline PSNR of 65.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8 on a custom toothbrush detection dataset; improved classification accuracy from 78% to 97.5% and deployed to a consumer mobile app.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (visual document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset in PyTorch; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing and model tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson with dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping; resolved 11 integration failures including false-positive detections and rolling-shutter stereo depth.
Built a three-layer vision-guided pick-and-place pipeline (Flutter → Flask-SocketIO → Jetson+Arduino); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) for lane and object detection; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD frames with zero manual annotation.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object detection and tracking; relayed control commands to STM32 over UART with multi-servo PWM and FreeRTOS task coordination.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels (memory coalescing, constant memory, preallocated buffers); achieved 49.2ms vs 77.5ms CPU baseline — ~35% speedup at identical accuracy.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
